section_summary.extract_value: This section details the participants for the study, which includes two distinct samples of Zimbabwean women. The first sample consists of 140 women from the community in Harare, Zimbabwe, with a mean age of 25.34 years and a mean self-reported BMI of 24.81. The second sample comprises 138 Zimbabwean women who are first-generation economic migrants from the community in London, Britain, with a mean age of 26.61 years and a mean self-reported BMI of 24.88.
